# Introduction

This is a Quarto template opened directly in Rmd Studio. The project tree on
the right shows the whole folder; double-click another `.qmd` file to switch to
it.

## What this demonstrates

- Quarto front matter (`format: pdf`)
- Rich text translated to clean Markdown
- R code chunks in a Quarto document
- Switching documents from the Files panel

```{r}
summary(cars)
```

> The PDF comes from Quarto and LaTeX, not from RStudio's editor.
